meta.name: genomic-intelligence
meta.description: Predict regulatory features, gene structure, and expression directly from DNA sequence using Genomic Intelligence's hosted transformer DNA language models — no local GPU or model weights. Six tasks over a REST API and a hosted MCP server (keyless public demo): promoter regions, splice donor/acceptor sites, enhancer activity, chromatin state, sequence-to-expression (log TPM), and de-novo gene annotation, plus a composite find-genes-then-predict-expression workflow. Use when the user has a gene symbol, a genomic region, or a DNA/FASTA sequence and wants any of these predictions, mentions Genomic Intelligence, genomicintelligence.ai, api.genomicintelligence.ai, or mcp.genomicintelligence.ai.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后,给出基因名、基因组区域或 DNA/FASTA 序列,Claude 会调用托管的 DNA 语言模型,回传启动子、剪接位点、增强子活性、染色质状态、表达量和基因注释等预测,无需本地 GPU。
howto.when: 当用户给出基因符号、基因组区域或 DNA/FASTA 序列并要求这些预测,或提到 Genomic Intelligence、genomicintelligence.ai 等名称时触发。

say.text: 预测 TP53 启动子区域。
say.note: 会调用 promoter 任务并返回该区域的启动子预测。

say.text: 在 K562 细胞中预测 HBB 基因表达量。
找一下这段 FASTA 里的基因并预测各自表达。
say.note: 会运行先找基因再预测表达的复合流程。

howto.what_en: Once installed, given a gene, region, or FASTA sequence, Claude calls hosted transformer DNA models to predict promoters, splice sites, enhancers, chromatin, expression (log TPM), and gene annotation. No GPU/weights needed.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user provides a gene symbol, genomic region, or DNA/FASTA sequence and asks for any of these predictions, or mentions Genomic Intelligence, genomicintelligence.ai, or related domains.

say_en.text: Predict the promoter region of TP53.
say_en.note: Runs the promoter task for that sequence.

say_en.text: Predict HBB expression in K562 cells.
say_en.note: Uses the TSS-centred 9,198 bp window and description.

say_en.text: Find genes in this FASTA and predict their expression.
